title: SOAP scanning (Alberto Verza, 2014 GSoC)
description: The 2014 SOAP scanning project in the Student Hall of Fame and the history of the soap add-on, which began as an importWSDL extension.

chapters.title: April to May 2014: WSDL import, renamed to soap
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists SOAP scanning (Alberto Verza) as a 2014 Summer GSoC project. A zap-extensions commit dated 2014-04-30 is titled "WSDL file import Add-On." On 2014-05-21 a commit is titled "" importWSDL " extension renamed to " soap ". SOAP Action scanner is no longer using ExtensionLoader to get data from ExtensionImportWSDL."

chapters.title: Summer 2014: scanners
chapters.text: Later commits include "SOAPAction spoofing scanner now performs some real checks (instead of the test ones)." (2014-05-27), "New WSDL File passive scanner added." (2014-06-12) and "New option to import a single WSDL file from a given URL." (2014-06-15; the log subject continues with a note on removing log4j). The project blog post dated 2014-09-03 says SOAP-specific scanners simulate attacks such as SOAP Action Spoofing and XML Injection and that the add-on passed GSoC final evaluations in alpha state.

chapters.title: 2019 to now
chapters.text: "soap: relocate to its own project" is dated 2019-04-03. The add-on is still in zap-extensions: commits include "soap: Allow limiting the number of messages imported" (2026-07-21) and "soap: Max Messsages GUI & API" (2026-08-02). The add-on's history contains 198 commits.
